name: Shin Ha-wan
source:
The muscular giant, Ha-wan, is the Academy’s gym teacher. With a fiery passion for physical health and a morale-boosting, he can inspire anyone who comes across him. He is the epitome of “All brawns and no brains.” But makes up for it with his kind and caring personality. Ha-wan tends to put others first, sometimes forgetting to make time for himself.

[From Kickstarter]
